step1_analysis.circuit_type: Injection-Locked Frequency Divider (ILFD) / LC Oscillator Core
step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled NMOS pair forming the core of an LC oscillator, with a tail transistor used for direct injection locking. It functions as a high-frequency, low-power frequency divider by locking its oscillation frequency to a sub-harmonic (typically divide-by-2) of the signal injected at the tail.

paper_reference.title: A CMOS Direct Injection-Locked Oscillator Topology as High-Frequency Low-Power Frequency Divider

operating_frequency.description: The frequency of the output signal, which should lock to exactly half of the injected input frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the LC tank resonance and the injected signal. With L=1nH and C=1pF added in the testbench, f_osc = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(LC)) ≈ 5.03 GHz. With a 10 GHz input injection, it will lock to exactly 5 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The testbench injects a 10 GHz signal, so the divider should lock to 5 GHz.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit from the supply.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the DC bias of the input signal (0.9V) and the tail transistor dimensions.

output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the output nodes.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported, but typically >0.5V for subsequent stages.

sky130_expected.calculation: Swing ≈ I_tail * R_tank. With I_tail = 1mA and R_tank = 500 ohms, single-ended swing is ~0.5V (1V peak-to-peak differential).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sufficient swing is needed to drive the next stage and ensure robust switching of the cross-coupled pair.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to verify injection locking (frequency division by 2), measure output frequency, voltage swing, and power consumption. An LC tank is added to complete the oscillator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Injection-Locked Frequency Divider Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.15u

* DUT
XM3 Q QX N_TAIL N_TAIL sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2 QX Q N_TAIL N_TAIL sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 N_TAIL IN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* LC Tank (added to make the oscillator functional)
L1 VDD Q 1n
L2 VDD QX 1n
C1 Q 0 1p
C2 QX 0 1p
R1 Q VDD 500
R2 QX VDD 500

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
* 10 GHz input signal for injection locking (divide-by-2 -> 5 GHz output)
VIN IN 0 DC 0.9 SIN(0.9 0.5 10G 0 0)

* Initial conditions to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(Q)=1.9 v(QX)=1.7

.control
* Run transient analysis
tran 2p 10n uic

* Measure operating frequency (should be 5 GHz)
meas tran t1 trig v(Q) val=1.8 rise=30 targ v(Q) val=1.8 rise=31
let freq = 1/t1
print freq

* Measure output voltage swing
meas tran vmax max v(Q) from=5n to=10n
meas tran vmin min v(Q) from=5n to=10n
let vpp = vmax - vmin
print vpp

* Measure power consumption
meas tran iavg avg i(VVDD) from=5n to=10n
let power = -iavg * 1.8
print power

quit
.endc
